summary: Defines what an IPv6 node should support so devices can work well together across many kinds of deployments. It collects the requirements in one place for implementers. It is informational, replaces RFC 4294, and was in turn replaced by RFC 8504.

eli5.summary: A checklist for what any IPv6 device should be able to do, so devices from different makers can talk. It replaced an older checklist and later got a newer one itself.

questions: what does an ipv6 node need to support
